findings.description: No composed/runnable 'config-drift detector' exists anywhere in the repo — only the pure diff functions and thin I/O adapters. Nothing wires REQ-010's process discovery into REQ-001/REQ-002's comparisons with REQ-004's fail-closed reporting as a single callable check, contradicting every EARS statement's 'WHEN config-drift detector が実行される'. REQ-008's required `queryLivePositions` primitive is unimplemented, and none of REQ-008's real-restart fresh evidence (PROP-014/021/022) exists anywhere under .vcsdd/features/config-delivery-verification/.
findings.requiredFix: Build a top-level orchestrator (analogous to healthcheck-runtime-loop.sh's `check`) that composes discovery + comparison + fail-closed reporting into one runnable detector; implement queryLivePositions; perform and record the real REQ-008 restart with fresh evidence.

findings.description: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` was added to the `claude -p` child spawn in the same diff, an undocumented, untested, unspecified security-relevant behavior change that directly contradicts this feature's own No-regression NFR ('REQ-009 は thinkClaudeP にタイムアウトを追加するだけであり、それ以外の分岐・フォールバック挙動は不変とする').
findings.requiredFix: Revert from this diff and land separately with its own spec+test+review, or add an explicit REQ documenting and testing it, with the No-regression NFR scoped to exclude it explicitly.

findings.description: resolveExpectedValue/detectBrainDrift conflate a null (unreadable) declaredConfig with an empty-but-successfully-read one; both fall back to codeDefault instead of the unreadable side ever producing a REQ-004 fail-closed FAIL. Untested in either direction.
findings.requiredFix: Apply classifyObservability to declaredConfig too, and return an unobservable FAIL when the declared side could not be read at all.

findings.description: The inner SIGKILL grace-period timer in thinkClaudeP is never captured/cleared, so a child that honors SIGTERM and exits cleanly within the grace period leaves a dangling timer that later fires kill() on an already-dead PID. This path (SIGTERM honored, clean exit before grace period) is not covered by either test fixture.
findings.requiredFix: Store and clear the inner grace-period timer on exit/error; add a third fixture/test for the SIGTERM-honored-then-exits-cleanly case.

findings.description: verification-architecture.md names a separate `runClaudePWithTimeout` effectful-shell function; the implementation inlines this logic directly in thinkClaudeP instead, deviating from the documented purity-boundary map without a REQ violation.
findings.requiredFix: Optional: extract into a standalone, independently testable function to match the documented architecture.
